case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: All core elements are available: clear objective, quantified $1.5M annual savings, multiple proof-point examples, and detailed approach and lever data.
case_study_packaging.headline: Fleet maintenance network captures $1.5M in annual savings and 5x ROI through rapid strategic sourcing program
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Epika Fleet Services had grown to eight autonomous business units through acquisition, each buying parts, lubricants, and supplies on its own. The decentralized model left the company with fragmented data, inconsistent pricing, and no leverage over national suppliers just months before its private-equity owner planned an exit. Leadership needed a fast, enterprise-wide procurement effort to unlock meaningful cost savings, protect margins, and strengthen the valuation story.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A nationwide fleet maintenance network had grown to eight autonomous business units through acquisition, each buying parts, lubricants, and supplies on its own. The decentralized model left the company with fragmented data, inconsistent pricing, and no leverage over national suppliers just months before the private equity ownership group planned an exit. Leadership needed a fast, enterprise-wide procurement effort to unlock meaningful cost savings, protect margins, and strengthen the valuation story.
approach_summary: Reconstructed a consolidated spend baseline by securing line-item histories directly from more than 40 high-spend suppliers, covering $18.3M in addressable spend.
Aggregated demand across all business units and renegotiated incumbent oil & lubricant, filter, and telematics contracts, driving 8–15% price reductions and richer rebates.
Ran a competitive RFQ for fleet fuel cards, consolidating six programs into a single Comdata solution with a guaranteed 1.8% rebate.
Leveraged OMNIA cooperative agreements to implement quick-win savings on office and industrial supplies without lengthy RFPs.
Fast-tracked contracting and phased roll-outs, enabling the client to realize first hard savings within 110 days and automating ongoing rebate tracking.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya unlocked $1.5 million in verified annual run-rate savings on $18.25 million of spend—more than double the $600K savings guarantee and delivering a 5x return on the client’s $300K project fee. Beyond the financial impact, the engagement established unified national supplier programs, created centralized spend visibility, and put automated rebate tracking in place to sustain value post-transaction.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered first category live within 110 days despite minimal internal spend data by sourcing records directly from suppliers.
Secured 82% of total savings via incumbent renegotiations, minimizing operational disruption and speeding time-to-value.
Met an aggressive six-month timeline aligned to the sponsor’s sale process, enhancing the valuation narrative.
Exceeded the contractual 2x savings guarantee by 150%, generating a 5x ROI on fees.
